name: Regular Meeting of the Public Safety Commission

REGULAR MEETING OF
  PUBLIC SAFETY COMMISSION

  CITY COUNCIL CHAMBERS
  18747 CLARKDALE AVE
  ARTESIA, CALIFORNIA - (562) 865-6262

  TUESDAY, MARCH 12, 2019

  6:00 P.M.

  CHAIRPERSON CHARLES OLIVER
  VICE CHAIRPERSON BETTY LOU ORMONDE
  COMMISSIONER MELINDA VEGA
  COMMISSIONER WILLIAM MOREY
  COMMISSIONER DEAN SORGDRAGER

CALL TO ORDER

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

ROLL CALL

COMMUNICATION FROM THE AUDIENCE

This is the time for public input relative to issues on or not on the printed agenda.
Please observe the time of three (3) minutes. Speaker Cards are available at the door
and may be delivered to the recording secretary prior to the commencement of the
meeting.

INFORMATIONAL ITEMS

  1. Sheriff’s Report of 2018

OLD BUSINESS

  1. Adopt the minutes from the October 2, 2018, meeting.

  2. Traffic signal at corner of Pioneer Boulevard & 167th Street.

  3. Provide a recommendation to the City Council on the Emergency Action
  Plan
 NEW BUSINESS

  4. Home Alarm Rebate Pilot Program

  5. Speed Limit Signage in Alleys

  6. Crossing Guard Program

  7. Severe Nuisance Abatement With City Personnel

  8. Public Safety Commission Meetings For 2019

COMMISSIONERS COMMENTS

  ADJOURNMENT OF THE REGULAR
  PUBLIC SAFETY COMMISSION
